_comment: Functional graphemes for French. Covers canonical digraphs/trigraphs (eau, ai, au, ou, oi, eu, ch, gn, qu, ill, gu, ph, th), word-final silent-consonant polygraphs (-eaux, -aux, -aud, -aut, -ault, -ot, -ent, -ant, -and, -ang, -ont, -ond, -ong, -omb, -emp, -amp, -aint, -eint, -ain, -ein, -eux) so the 1:1 segmenter can handle words with silent trailing consonants, plus accented letters and single unaccented letters as fallback. See data-prep/docs/grapheme-phoneme-alignment.md for known limitations (silent letters mid-word, polyphonic graphemes like oi→/wa/).
